evals.name: typescript-3-ci
evals.prompt: Add @data-client/react with REST to our React app (yarn, no Next.js). Our package.json has `"typescript": "~3.9.7"` because our mobile CI job still builds with it, and `tsc --noEmit` must keep passing there.
evals.expected_output: Says @data-client needs TypeScript 4.0 or later and that 3.9 won't type-check, and upgrades typescript (or tells the user the CI job must move to 4.0+) before installing, instead of hiding the errors.
assertions: The response says @data-client requires TypeScript 4.0 or later.
The response does not claim @data-client works with TypeScript 3.9.
The response raises the `typescript` version to 4.0 or later, or tells the user the CI job has to.
It does not hide the type errors with `skipLibCheck`, `@ts-ignore`, or a hand-written `typesVersions`/declaration shim.
